changeSet.sql: UPDATE disciplines SET status = CASE WHEN c.status = 'COMPLETED' THEN 'COMPLETED' ELSE 'STARTED' END FROM competitions c WHERE c.id = disciplines.competition_id AND (c.status = 'COMPLETED' OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM attempt_results a WHERE a.discipline_id = disciplines.id) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM parallel_sprint_brackets b JOIN parallel_sprint_heats h ON h.bracket_id = b.id WHERE b.discipline_id = disciplines.id AND (h.status_1 IS NOT NULL OR h.status_2 IS NOT NULL)))
ALTER TABLE disciplines ADD CONSTRAINT disciplines_status_check CHECK (status IN ('CREATED', 'STARTED', 'COMPLETED'))
